newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Shell makes best offer in Nepal kerosene tender.
newsitem.headline: Shell makes best offer in Nepal kerosene tender.

text.p: Shell Singapore has made the lowest offer to state-owned Nepal Oil Corp's (NOC) tender to buy 30,000 tonnes of superior kerosene at just under $195 per tonne cost-and-freight (c-and-f) Indian east coast, industry sources said on Monday.
The tender for July 21-31 delivery closed on June 24 and offers were valid until June 26. The result is expected to be known later on Thursday.
In its last tender, NOC bought one cargo for July 1-10 delivery at $199.37 per tonne c-and-f Indian east coast from Dutch trader Vitol, they said.
